description: Take actions on Rigor workflows — currently supports cancel (single or bulk). Send confirm: false (default) for a preview of what would be affected. Send confirm: true to execute. Use force: true only for executing workflows that are stuck.

confirm.description: false (default) = preview only; true = execute the action

workflow_ids.description: Array of workflow_id values to act on (max 20)

title: Manage Rigor workflows
